_doc: Screenplay Ingest Schema Contract v1 — defines the exact JSON structure that screenplay_ingest.py must produce to feed render_longform.py. Derived from normalize_script() + _canonicalize_config() + _normalize_shot_list() in render_longform.py.
_purpose: The ingest parser reads a raw screenplay (PDF, TXT, Fountain, HTML) and emits a JSON file conforming to this schema. render_longform.py consumes it without modification.

slug.description: URL-safe production identifier. Derived from screenplay title. Used for output directory name under productions/.
slug.ingest_rule: Slugify the screenplay title: lowercase, underscores for spaces, strip punctuation. Append _v1.

title.example: DAVID — Charlemagne: The Emperor Who Named the Months
title.ingest_rule: Use the screenplay title page title verbatim, or construct from slug.

format_id.description: Production format template. Determines render pipeline behavior (camera defaults, identity lock, seamless config).
format_id.ingest_rule: Classify from screenplay genre/content. Dialogue-heavy with single host → documentary-host. Action/drama → narrative-short-film or movies. Science/educational → science-explainer. Default: narrative-short-film for screenplays.

target_seconds.description: Total target duration in seconds. Computed from shot durations or estimated from page count (~1 min/page for dialogue-heavy, ~30s/page for action).
target_seconds.ingest_rule: Sum of all shot durations, or estimate from screenplay page count.

concept.ingest_rule: Extract from title page or first action block if it reads as a logline.

intake.description: Production intake metadata. The ingest parser populates what it can; Gate 0 fields are left for downstream.

fields.actor_id: string — @CHAR_NNN catalog ref or character name for HITL resolution
fields.set_id: string — @SET_NNN catalog ref or location name for HITL resolution
fields.gate_0: object — compliance gate (populated downstream, not by ingest)

intake.ingest_rule: Populate actor_id with protagonist name (HITL resolves to @CHAR later). Set set_id from primary location. Suggest style_id from genre.

config.description: Render configuration. The ingest parser sets defaults; operator overrides before render.

prompt_mode.description: seamless = full continuity-lock prompts built by renderer. barebones = shot.barebones slots are the prompt (operator-authored direction). Ingest parser should default to seamless for screenplays.

voice_suffix.description: Voice direction appended to every shot prompt. Describes vocal quality.
voice_suffix.ingest_rule: Extract from screenplay character descriptions or parentheticals. Default: 'natural conversational voice, synthetic performer only'.

identity_lock.description: Path to identity lock JSON (for host/performer continuity). null if no locked performer.
identity_lock.ingest_rule: null for screenplays unless a known performer is specified.

avatar_reference.ingest_rule: null — populated by operator before render.

set_reference.description: Path to primary set reference image.
set_reference.ingest_rule: null — populated by operator before render.

seamless.description: Seamless extend/crossfade config for shot concatenation.
seamless.ingest_rule: Use defaults for screenplays. Action-heavy scripts may want cut_on_motion: false.

style_dna_tag.description: Global visual style modifier ID from style_modifier_registry.
style_dna_tag.ingest_rule: Suggest from screenplay genre/tone. Film noir → style_fincher_khondji. Period drama → style_deakins_villeneuve. Animation → anim_* or gameart_*. null if uncertain (operator picks).

audio_dna_tag.ingest_rule: Suggest from genre. Thriller → sound_fincher_khondji. Sci-fi → sound_davis_matrix. null if uncertain.

music_dna_tag.ingest_rule: Suggest from genre. Epic → music_williams_leitmotif. Tension → music_herrmann_suspense. null if uncertain.

pacing_dna_tag.ingest_rule: Suggest from screenplay pace. null if uncertain.

director_persona_id.ingest_rule: null for most screenplays — operator choice.

language.ingest_rule: Detect from dialogue language. English → 'en'. Multilingual → specific profile or null.

branch_chain.description: Branch-chain render config (for segmented renders). null for standard linear renders.
branch_chain.ingest_rule: null for standard screenplays. Set if format requires branch rendering.

native_av.description: true = inject sonic DNA clauses into prompts.
native_av.ingest_rule: true for narrative content with important sound design. null/false for dialogue-heavy.

shots.description: Ordered list of shots/scenes. Each shot becomes one video generation call.

id.ingest_rule: Sequential numbering + slugified scene heading or beat description.

duration.ingest_rule: Estimate from dialogue word count (~150 wpm = 2.5 words/sec) + action line length. Min 5s, max 15s per shot. Split longer scenes into multiple shots.

t_start.description: Cumulative start time in seconds. Auto-computed by normalize_script if missing.
t_start.ingest_rule: Cumulative sum of prior shot durations.

video_prompt.description: The complete visual direction for video generation. In seamless mode, renderer builds this from continuity locks + shot description. In barebones mode, this is the raw prompt.
video_prompt.ingest_rule: Construct from: action lines (visual description) + parentheticals (performance direction) + camera notes (if specified in screenplay). Do NOT include dialogue text — that goes in speech_text. Include character visual descriptions from screenplay character intros.

speech_text.description: Dialogue to be lip-synced. Exact spoken words.
speech_text.ingest_rule: Extract dialogue blocks verbatim. Strip character name prefix. Preserve parenthetical directions separately.

speech_lang.description: Language code for dialogue when not the default production language.
speech_lang.ingest_rule: Detect from parentheticals like '(in French)' or non-English dialogue.

modifiers.description: Per-shot modifier overrides. Same keys as config-level modifiers.
modifiers.ingest_rule: Set when a scene has distinctly different tone/style from the overall production. Use camera_move from screenplay camera directions (PAN, DOLLY, CRANE, STEADICAM, etc.).

barebones.description: Barebones prompt slots — only used when config.prompt_mode = 'barebones'.
barebones.ingest_rule: Only populate if config.prompt_mode = 'barebones'. For standard screenplay ingest, use seamless mode (video_prompt + speech_text).

fields.enabled: boolean — true to render end card
fields.title: string — card title
fields.subtitle: string — card subtitle

provenance_card.ingest_rule: enabled: true. title: screenplay title. subtitle: 'Based on screenplay by [writer]'. footer: writer/source credit. card_type: 'credits'.

qa_rules.ingest_rule: Use defaults. require_identity_lock: false for screenplays (no locked performer yet).

guardrails.description: Content guardrails (violence level, nudity policy, language restrictions).
guardrails.ingest_rule: Infer from screenplay content. Flag for HITL if R-rated content detected.

screenplay_parsing_contract._doc: Rules for the format parser that feeds this schema.
screenplay_parsing_contract.scene_heading_to_shot: Each INT./EXT. scene heading becomes one or more shots. Split if scene exceeds 15s estimated duration.
screenplay_parsing_contract.action_to_video_prompt: Action lines become the video_prompt. Describe what the camera sees.
screenplay_parsing_contract.dialogue_to_speech_text: Dialogue blocks (under CHARACTER NAME) become speech_text. Character name stripped.
screenplay_parsing_contract.parenthetical_to_direction: Parentheticals like (whispering) or (in French) inform voice direction or speech_lang.
screenplay_parsing_contract.transition_to_shot_boundary: CUT TO:, DISSOLVE TO:, FADE IN/OUT mark shot boundaries. Transition type informs seamless config.
screenplay_parsing_contract.camera_direction_to_modifier: ANGLE ON, PAN TO, DOLLY IN, CRANE UP etc. map to modifiers.camera_move.
screenplay_parsing_contract.character_extraction: First appearance of CHARACTER NAME in dialogue → extract for intake.actor_id. Visual description from action lines near first appearance → bake into video_prompt for shots featuring that character.
screenplay_parsing_contract.location_extraction: INT./EXT. LOCATION - TIME → extract location for intake.set_id. Description from action lines → video_prompt environmental detail.

example_output._doc: What the ingest parser produces from a simple screenplay scene.
example_output.input_screenplay:
INT. MOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

A dingy motel room. Rain streaks the window. VINCENT (40s, disheveled suit, tired eyes) sits on the bed, gun on the nightstand.

VINCENT
(quietly)
You know what they call a Quarter Pounder with cheese in Paris?

JULES (O.S.)
They don't call it a Quarter Pounder with cheese?

VINCENT
No man, they got the metric system. They call it a Royale with cheese.

config.voice_suffix: natural conversational voice, synthetic performer only

shots.video_prompt: Interior dingy motel room at night. Rain streaks down the window pane. Dim overhead light casts harsh shadows. A man in a disheveled suit sits on the edge of the bed, a handgun resting on the nightstand beside him. Camera: static wide establishing shot.
Medium shot of Vincent (40s, disheveled dark suit, tired eyes) sitting on motel bed. Dim warm practicals. Rain sound. He speaks quietly, conversational, looking off-camera to someone out of frame.
shots.speech_text: You know what they call a Quarter Pounder with cheese in Paris?

shots.video_prompt: Same motel room. Camera holds on Vincent reacting to off-screen voice. Slight head tilt, listening.
shots.speech_text: They don't call it a Quarter Pounder with cheese?

shots.video_prompt: Medium close-up on Vincent. Small knowing smile. Conversational delivery, matter-of-fact.
shots.speech_text: No man, they got the metric system. They call it a Royale with cheese.
